sources.authors: Manuel Leal, Cesar Lozano Huerta, Montserrat Vite
sources.title: Birational Geometry of Linear Determinantal Quartic 3-Folds and Rationality
sources.checked_claim: General linear determinantal quartics in P4 are rational, with an incidence construction birational to P3. Only the generic open set is used.

sources.authors: Janos Kollar lectures, Karen E. Smith, appendix by Joel Rosenberg
sources.title: Rational and Non-Rational Algebraic Varieties
sources.checked_claim: For a normal integral projective scheme over an appropriate DVR with rational generic fiber, every irreducible special component is ruled. The proof uses the normalized birational graph and exceptional divisors over regular projective space.

sources.authors: C. Herbert Clemens, Phillip A. Griffiths
sources.title: The Intermediate Jacobian of the Cubic Threefold
sources.location: Theorem 13.12, printed p.350; Appendix B, printed pp.352-353
sources.checked_claim: Every smooth complex cubic threefold is irrational; Appendix B gives a unirational parametrization.

sources.authors: Jean-Louis Colliot-Thelene, Nikita A. Karpenko, Alexander S. Merkurjev
sources.title: Rational surfaces and canonical dimension of PGL_6
sources.checked_claim: Castelnuovo's theorem: unirational integral surfaces over algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields are rational.

sources.title: Algebraic Deformations of Polarized Varieties
sources.checked_claim: Historical ruledness-specialization result; the exact componentwise DVR statement used here is the one in the Kollar lectures.
